info.title: SouthLeaf Public API (browsing + stage-two booking entry)
info.description: Stage-one public browsing plus the stage-two customer booking entry. The entry opens a request only: it never holds a slot, never creates an order and never models a payment. WeChat login is the identity basis; a phone number is optional and is not collected by this contract.

post.summary: 提交预约申请（不占档、不建单、不收款）
post.description: 申请写入与审计、outbox 在同一事务；申请不写入占用表，档期只由运营方人工确认时占用。同一客户同时只允许一笔待确认申请。
